<!-- pr-reviewer: a163d62e34dce5bbe7cfb376af73db620d18f605 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one blocker: line endings). The code itself is good.

### What looks good
- `TurnFixture` is an undoable command. It writes the new rotation at creation through `MoveFixture::locating`, so riders move and undo restores the previous `Location`.
- Validation is at creation: an axis above 2, a non-finite angle, an unknown or unwritable fixture and a turn that changes nothing are refused by name.
- The turn pivots about the fixture origin and premultiplies the rotation (world axis). `settle_rot` keeps quarter turns exact and the quaternion canonical.
- All readers of the fixture shape (`model::world_facets`, `entity_world_aabb`, `setup_align::facets_in`, `fixture::workholding_for` / `boxes_for` / `meshes_for`, `fixture_struck`, `fixture_carried`, the swing posting checks, the viewport) apply `transform_of` with the rotation. I found no reader that uses an unturned shape.
- The MCP tool `turn_fixture` ships with the command, with its skill row. The body has `Process change: yes`, and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited.
- No project-format change: the rotation is already in `Location.rot`.
- No `unwrap()` / `expect()` / `panic!` on a user path. New files have provenance lines and are under 400 lines. Screenshots, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2174` are in the body.

### Results merged with main (locally, trial merge of `origin/main` 1f15f98e7, no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `fixture_turn` | 5 passed |
| app `mcp_fixture_turn` | 1 passed |
| app `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| app `fixture_plate_riders` | 7 passed |
| app `move_interpenetration` | 8 passed |
| app `fixture_locate` | 11 passed |
| app `fixture_mesh_posed` | 2 passed |
| app `commands_undo` | 30 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 73 passed |
| app `mcp` | 22 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 949 passed, 6 ignored |
| ui `--test fixtures` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

I also ran a local probe (not pushed) for these items:
- Sign: a bar that hangs on its own -Z beside a Face pass. `Turn X+` (90) moves it to +Y, away from the pass (right-hand rule). `Turn X-` (-90) lays it across the pass. Then `verification_gate` reports "strikes a fixture" and `post_setup_unwritten` refuses: `post blocked - Face1: flute at move 2 strikes a fixture; ...`. Undo clears the strike.
- Odd angles (`±1e300`, `1e-9`, `720.000001`, `f64::MIN_POSITIVE`, `45`, `-270`, `inf`, `NaN`): no panic, the quaternion stays unit length, and the bad values are refused.

### Requested before merge
1. **CRLF line endings.** The commit changes six files from LF to CRLF. GitHub shows each one as a full rewrite. This hides the real change, breaks `git blame`, and causes a conflict with each open PR that touches these files.

   | File | Lines with CR on main | Lines with CR on the PR |
   |---|---|---|
   | `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs` | 0 | 336 (real change: 3 lines) |
   | `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs` | 0 | 295 (real change: 1 line) |
   | `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` | 0 | 364 (real change: 1 line) |
   | `crates/app/src/fixture_clash.rs` | 0 | 240 (real change: about 48 lines) |
   | `crates/ui/tests/fixtures.rs` | 0 | 201 (real change: 2 lines) |
   | `crates/app/src/commands/fixture_turn.rs` (new) | - | 123 |

   Fix: convert these files to LF (for example `dos2unix` on each file, or set `core.autocrlf=input` and run `git add --renormalize .`). Then commit and push. After the fix, `git diff origin/main --stat` must show only the real lines.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- **A stale block after a turn to a clear position (pre-existing, safe direction).** My probe generated Face1 with the bar across the pass (20 cached generation warnings). Then it turned the bar 180 degrees about X, away from the pass. The live `verification_gate` has no fixture lines. But `post_setup_unwritten` still refuses with `post blocked - 20 warning(s): Face1: flute at move 2 strikes a fixture; ...`. That text comes from the cached warnings of the earlier generation (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:788`; the same path is in `posting_per_op.rs` and `posting_mounts.rs`). The op status stays `Ok`, so the user gets no hint to regenerate. This is conservative (a false block, never a false clear), and `MoveFixture` has the same behaviour today. But `docs/decisions/2174-fixture-turns.md` says that a turn needs no regenerate. I recommend a `P3` follow-up issue: "post stays blocked by cached fixture warnings after the fixture moves clear". Please also correct the decision text, or name the follow-up in it.
- A turn below about 1e-5 degrees is refused as "nothing to do". This is acceptable. For `1e300` the refusal message prints a 300-digit number. This is cosmetic.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is about 4660 lines (far over 400 before this PR). The PR moves the dispatch arms to `state_fixture_turn.rs`, so the net growth is small. This is only a note.
- Not exercised: the GUI was not started (the screenshots in the body show the dialog). The pixel snapshots were not run (release lane).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
